name: Solution Space Projection Dimension
description: Frame the connectivity requirement as restricting the dimension of the solution space projected onto the target coordinates. Instead of asking to "connect" variables or make them "equal", we require that the projection of the null space onto the critical variables has dimension exactly 1. Models must algebraically deduce that this dimension equals the number of connected components intersecting the critical set, forcing them to reason about the structure rather than pattern-matching "equations equal to a single value" to "tree connectivity".
